campaign_logline: A desperate pilot navigates a crumbling economy and shifting loyalties in the outer rim.
campaign_pitch: Resource shortages are destabilizing the inner systems. You must navigate the friction between three expanding powers.
campaign_story_summary: The Zenith Corporation seeks to monopolize energy cores. The Aurelia Collective values decentralized trade routes. The Vanguard protects the borders against pirates. You start as a pilot seeking enough credits to refuel your ship.

opening.status_quo: The local sector is suffering from severe fuel shortages.
opening.visible_crisis: Pirates are raiding trade convoys and stealing essential supplies.
opening.hidden_crisis: A massive decline in natural energy deposits is causing systemic instability.
opening.why_now: Recent blockade measures have forced traders to take riskier routes.
opening.player_role: You are a freelance pilot trying to stay solvent.

mystery.question: Why is the fuel shortage so sudden and severe?
mystery.false_answer: The shortages are caused by pirate raids on supply lines.
mystery.true_answer_hint: A secret industrial project is draining the local energy fields.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: The true cause involves deep-space mining infrastructure.

kaelen.secret_angle: She monitors the flow of illegal trade data.
kaelen.address_rule: Refer to her as a broker or fixer.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Her true purpose is hidden from all observers.

factions.zenith_problem: Zenith seeks to control the energy market through heavy-handed tactics.
factions.aurelia_problem: Aurelia wants to keep trade routes open for independent traders.
factions.vanguard_problem: Vanguard is struggling to maintain safety in a lawless zone.
factions.conflict_triangle: The three factions are competing for the last known energy hubs.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Independent pilots must choose sides or risk being stranded.

act_1.name: The Scarcity Hunt
act_1.goal: Secure enough fuel to reach a stable station.
act_1.opening_incident: A cargo ship is intercepted by a pirate vessel.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You find a shipment of high-grade energy cores.
act_1.finale: You deliver the haul and gain your first contract from Kaelen.
act_1.player_takeaway: Survival in this sector requires finding reliable allies.

starter_mission.title: The Last Shipment
starter_mission.reason: A shipment of cargo is being contested by a pirate ship.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: The pirate knows the value of the haul.
starter_mission.aftershock: You find a log indicating the pirates are desperate.

recurring_clue.name: Flickering Beacons
recurring_clue.signal: A rhythmic pulse from an abandoned mining station.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: Detected during the first jump to a new sector.
recurring_clue.escalation: The frequency of the pulses increases as you approach hubs.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: The beacons are linked to the automated mining network.

rumor_trail.name: The Ghost Route
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Whispers of a hidden trade route.
clue_templates: "They say the old path is still active."
rumor_trail.payoff: A shortcut through a hazardous zone.

horizon.gate_tease: The next gate leads to systems with more stable resources.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: New systems are revealed only when the player enters a gate.
horizon.future_faction_tease: Rumors of a distant, militant group called the Iron Reach.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: Rare minerals found in deep-space mining zones.

regeneration_trigger.description: When Act 1 is complete, reveal the next stage of the scarcity crisis.

rules.fall_back_rule: If a player action is not specified, default to a trade-focused outcome.

story_questions_for_future_generation: What are the consequences of choosing a side in the conflict?
Why is the energy crisis causing such extreme measures?
How does Kaelen's role as a fixer affect her knowledge of the rest of world?
Who is funding the system-wide fuel shortage?
Where is the source of the hidden mining infrastructure?
